pathways.activity: Specify constructs, hypotheses and item coding
Import, label, missingness, reverse code and log edits
pathways.safeguard: Do not delete cases by automatic rules

pathways.activity: Summarize sample and variable distributions
Assess alpha/omega, KMO, Bartlett, anti-image MSA
pathways.safeguard: Factorability is not validity by itself

pathways.activity: Select extraction/rotation based on research aim
pathways.safeguard: Retain factors using theory and evidence

pathways.activity: Check assumptions, regress intention on predictors
pathways.safeguard: Interpret effects/uncertainty rather than p alone

pathways.activity: Only if theory supports indirect pathways
Report limitations, decisions and findings
Classify independent/between/within mixed design
pathways.safeguard: Random assignment differs from random sampling

pathways.activity: Check group codes, outcomes, missingness and manipulation
Compare distributions and group means
Inspect independence, residuals, variances, sphericity where applicable
pathways.safeguard: Do not use blanket normality thresholds

pathways.activity: Run planned contrasts or omnibus test
Report contrasts, corrected comparisons and CI
ANCOVA, factorial, repeated/mixed ANOVA
Write conclusions constrained to design
pathways.safeguard: Avoid causal claims for non-randomized data

pathways.activity: Specify latent constructs and indicator operationalization
Contrast PLS-SEM and CB-SEM
pathways.safeguard: Selection must not be based on sample size alone

pathways.activity: Clean codes, missing items and response patterns
Draw SmartPLS path model and specify measurement mode
Assess loadings, reliability, AVE, HTMT; formative if needed
pathways.safeguard: Do not remove indicators solely to raise AVE

pathways.activity: Check VIF, paths, uncertainty, R², f²
Assess out-of-sample PLSpredict/CVPAT when relevant
Indirect effects, moderation, MICOM/MGA if hypotheses justify
pathways.safeguard: MICOM before MGA; no unmotivated complexity

pathways.activity: Document settings, bootstrap and limitations
